!Series_summary	"Patient-derived cells (PDC) recapitulate the characteristics of lung cancer and its therapeutic response. We collected cancer cells of patients to receive various chemotherapy and performed integrative analysis for pharmachogenomics."
!Series_overall_design	"To identify the genomics characteristics, RNA-Seq and target-seq dataset was collected from lung cancer PDC of refractory patients. Drug response screening was performed from matched samples, and susceptibilities according to gene expression and variants were tested."

!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1	"Pleural effusions, pericardium effusions, ascites and tissues were obtained by lung cancer patients at National Cancer Center. All experiments utilizing human material were approved by NCC IRB. For liquid samples, effusions were transferred to conical tube and centrifuged at 120 x g for 10 min. The cell pellet was resuspended in RPMI and carefully layered onto LSM (Lymphocyte Separation Medium, #091692249 MP Biomedicals, France). After centrifugation at 400 x g for 30 min at room temperature, interphase layer between RPMI and LSM including tumor cells was harvested and washed with RPMI. For tissue sample, tumor tissues were minced finely and washed with RPMI. After washing, cells from effusion or tissue were cultured in AR-5 medium (5% FBS, 1 X GlutaMAX (Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1 X ITS (Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium, Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1% Penicillin/streptomycin, 50 nM hydrocortisone, 1 mM Sodium Pyruvate and 1 ng/ml EGF in RPMI) at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere." "Pleural effusions, pericardium effusions, ascites and tissues were obtained by lung cancer patients at National Cancer Center. All experiments utilizing human material were approved by NCC IRB. For liquid samples, effusions were transferred to conical tube and centrifuged at 120 x g for 10 min. The cell pellet was resuspended in RPMI and carefully layered onto LSM (Lymphocyte Separation Medium, #091692249 MP Biomedicals, France). After centrifugation at 400 x g for 30 min at room temperature, interphase layer between RPMI and LSM including tumor cells was harvested and washed with RPMI. For tissue sample, tumor tissues were minced finely and washed with RPMI. After washing, cells from effusion or tissue were cultured in AR-5 medium (5% FBS, 1 X GlutaMAX (Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1 X ITS (Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium, Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1% Penicillin/streptomycin, 50 nM hydrocortisone, 1 mM Sodium Pyruvate and 1 ng/ml EGF in RPMI) at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere." After washing, cells from effusion or tissue were cultured in AR-5 medium (5% FBS, 1 X GlutaMAX (Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1 X ITS (Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium, Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1% Penicillin/streptomycin, 50 nM hydrocortisone, 1 mM Sodium Pyruvate and 1 ng/ml EGF in RPMI) at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere." After washing, cells from effusion or tissue were cultured in AR-5 medium (5% FBS, 1 X GlutaMAX (Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1 X ITS (Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium, Thermo Fisher Scientific), 1% Penicillin/streptomycin, 50 nM hydrocortisone, 1 mM Sodium Pyruvate and 1 ng/ml EGF in RPMI) at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere."
